g.text: Power entry: reverse protection, TVS, 9-36 V -> 5 V buck

g.desc: Power entry: reverse protection, TVS, 9-36 V -> 5 V buck

g.text: USB / buck power mux and 3.3 V LDO

g.desc: USB / buck power mux and 3.3 V LDO

g.text: 1. 9-36 V in (24 V nominal) or USB-C alone. TPS2116 prefers the buck 5 V; ST (PWR_SRC) low = on USB.

g.desc: 1. 9-36 V in (24 V nominal) or USB-C alone. TPS2116 prefers the buck 5 V; ST (PWR_SRC) low = on USB.

g.text: 2. USB-only: +5V, +3V3, CAN, RS-485, EEPROM and J_EXP work; DI and DO need the 24 V field supply.

g.desc: 2. USB-only: +5V, +3V3, CAN, RS-485, EEPROM and J_EXP work; DI and DO need the 24 V field supply.

g.text: 3. DI field side (FGND) is isolated: no GND copper under it. DO are sourcing, referenced to GND.

g.desc: 3. DI field side (FGND) is isolated: no GND copper under it. DO are sourcing, referenced to GND.

g.text: 4. FDCAN2 on PB12/PB13 (FDCAN1 pins collide with USB and BOOT0). BOOT0 = PB8 pin, button to 3V3.

g.desc: 4. FDCAN2 on PB12/PB13 (FDCAN1 pins collide with USB and BOOT0). BOOT0 = PB8 pin, button to 3V3.

g.text: 5. CAN split termination via SW4, RS-485 termination via JP2. Fail-safe bias always fitted.

g.desc: 5. CAN split termination via SW4, RS-485 termination via JP2. Fail-safe bias always fitted.
